This script contains univariate analyses at the network level + amygdala and hippocampus, and behavioral analyses, for the reframe-detail project. 


# Setup 
```{r}
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ez)
library(ggsegSchaefer)
library(ggseg3d)
library(ggseg)
library(sjPlot)
library(kableExtra)
library(corrplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(officer)
library(rvg)
library(emmeans)


# Calculations 
zscore <- function(x) (x-mean(x))/sd(x)
se <- function(x) sqrt(var(x)/length(x))  #function to calculate SE
ci <- function(x) (sqrt(var(x)/length(x))) * 1.96  #function to calculate 95% CI


#Plotting theme 
fontsize <- 14
linesize <- .5
barcolors <- c("#f76c67","#67aaf7","#0bca81","#f6a84f","#9c67f7","#67f7f0","#7F7F7F")

my_theme <- function() {
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=fontsize, margin=margin(0,0,20,0)),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 1), 
        axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = .8*fontsize, hjust=1, vjust=1, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = .8*fontsize), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 1*fontsize),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position="none", 
        strip.text.x = element_text(size=fontsize), 
        text = element_text(family="Helvetica")) # +
  # theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
}
```

## Load data 

### behavioral data
```{r}
behav <- read.csv('/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/behav_data_allonsets.csv')

behav <- behav %>%
  filter(period=="recall") # keep only one row per trial

nina_behav <- read.csv('/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/onsets_all.csv')
nina_behav <- nina_behav %>%
  filter(period=="recall")

behav$eventDet = nina_behav$eventDetails.y # adding nina's add'l coding 
behav$visualDet = nina_behav$visualDetails.y


# add in missing data from nina's coding 
missing = read.csv('/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/missing_coded.csv')
behav <- behav %>%
  left_join(missing, by = c("subID", "videoName"))
behav$eventDets = ifelse(is.na(behav$eventDet.x), behav$eventDet.y, behav$eventDet.x)
behav$visualDets = ifelse(is.na(behav$visualDet.x), behav$visualDet.y, behav$visualDet.x)

# remove unnecessary columns 
behav = behav %>% select(-eventDet.x, -visualDet.x, -eventDet.y, -visualDet.y)


table(behav$subID,behav$run)
nsub.behav <- length(unique(behav$subID))

# Some video info is contained only for the first round. Make sure it's repeated for other rounds. 
behav.roundone <- behav %>% 
  filter(regRound==1) %>%
  select("subID","videoName","recallValence","recallArousal","recallVividness",
         "encValence","encArousal","valenceChange","arousalChange","successful",
         "remembered","correctDetails", "eventDets", "visualDets")
behav.left <- behav[,1:18]

behav.all <- full_join(behav.left,behav.roundone,by=c("subID","videoName"),
                       suffix=c("",".ignore"))


# no event/visual detail column should have "NA" - replace with zero. 

behav.all$eventDets = ifelse(is.na(behav.all$eventDets), 0, behav.all$eventDets)
behav.all$visualDets = ifelse(is.na(behav.all$visualDets), 0, behav.all$visualDets)
```

### cleaning 

#### Define factors 
```{r}
alldata$ROI <- as.factor(alldata$ROI)
alldata$conditionName <- as.factor(alldata$conditionName)
alldata$valenceCategory <- as.factor(alldata$valenceCategory)
alldata$subID <- as.factor(alldata$subID)
alldata$regRound.categ <- as.factor(alldata$regRound) # keep both integer & categorical versions
alldata$videoName <- as.factor(alldata$videoName)
alldata$periodLabel <- as.factor(alldata$periodLabel)
```

#### Remove outliers

Defined as values abs(z)>4, calculated within subject and ROI - as in Cooper & Ritchey 2020 parcel analysis

Note that these time-points come from the residuals of a nuisance regressor-only model, which included run regressors that account for mean differences between runs.

```{r}
### add z score of activity estimates within region and subject and time-period
alldata <- alldata %>%
  group_by(subID, ROI, periodLabel) %>%
  mutate(Z = zscore(regulationActivity)) %>%
  ungroup()

# remove betas that are > 4SD 
tmp <- alldata %>%
  mutate(isOutlier = ifelse(abs(Z)>4,TRUE,FALSE))

# Following Cooper & Ritchey, remove trials where mean for ANY ROI is an outlier
outliers <- tmp %>%
  select(isOutlier,subID,trial) %>%
  filter(isOutlier) %>%
  unique()
alldata <- left_join(alldata,outliers,by=c("subID","trial"))
alldata$isOutlier[is.na(alldata$isOutlier)] <- FALSE

# Summarize number of outliers
table(alldata$subID,alldata$isOutlier)
table(alldata$isOutlier)

alldata$regulationActivity[alldata$isOutlier] <- NA  #mark value as NA if outlier
```

#### Trial filters 
Removing reappraisal trials that were initially collected for a separate study; 
filtering trials to remembered-only 
```{r}
alldata <- alldata %>%
  mutate(isComplete.emo = ifelse(is.na(valenceChange) | is.na(arousalChange),
                             FALSE,TRUE))

# Removing negative reappraisal (non-memory) trials
alldata <- alldata %>%
  filter(conditionName == "remember")


all_nr = alldata # capturing all trials, not just remembered 

alldata <- alldata %>% filter(remembered == 1) # only looking at remembered-only data! 
```


#### Mean centering predictors 
Within-participant 
```{r}
alldata <- alldata %>%
  group_by(subID,ROI,periodLabel) %>% 
  mutate(regSuccess = scale(regSuccess,scale=FALSE),
         valenceChange = scale(valenceChange,scale=FALSE),
         arousalChange = scale(arousalChange,scale=FALSE),
         recallVividness = scale(recallVividness,scale=FALSE),
         eventDets = scale(eventDets, scale =FALSE), 
         visualDets = scale(visualDets, scale=FALSE),
         correctDetails = scale(correctDetails, scale=FALSE)) %>% # mean-center within subject
  ungroup()

# double check that this worked as expected
tmp <- alldata %>% filter(valenceCategory=="neg" & ROI=="LH_HIPP") %>% group_by(subID) %>% summarize(meansucc = mean(regSuccess,na.rm=TRUE))
```

# Analysis: DMN subnetwork activity 

## setup 
```{r}
rois <- levels(alldata$ROI)
outDir <- '/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/reframe-detail_timepoint_results/'
alphafdr <- .05
```

get network-level data:
```{r}
include_networks = c("DefaultA","DefaultB","DefaultC", "HIPP", "AMYG")

# Summarize data
alldata %>%
  # filter to include only some rows
  filter(network %in% include_networks) %>%
  # average over ROIs within a network
  group_by(subID,trial, cueWord.act, network, eventDets, visualDets, correctDetails, valenceCategory) %>% 
  summarize(regulationActivity = mean(regulationActivity,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() -> network.data
```

create function for running model:
```{r}
model.stats <- data.frame()


# define function
detail_emo_neuref <- function(curROI,model.stats) {
  
  # model
  roiData <- network.data %>% filter(network %in% curROI)
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
  full.model <- lmer(regulationActivity ~ visualDets + eventDets + 
                       visualDets*valenceCategory +eventDets*valenceCategory + (1|subID), data = roiData)
  
  print(tab_model(full.model,title="detail x emotion, neutral reference"))
                
  
  stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats,ROI=curROI)
  model.stats <- rbind(model.stats,stats)
  
  p <- plot_model(full.model, show.values = TRUE, show.p = FALSE,
           value.offset = .3, vline.color = "gray30",
           colors=c("lightskyblue","steelblue"), type = "std") + ylim(c(-.3,.3)) +
    ggtitle(curROI) +
  my_theme()
  print(p)
  
  return(model.stats)
}
```

## run models
```{r}
model.stats <- detail_emo_neuref("DefaultA",model.stats)
model.stats <- detail_emo_neuref("DefaultB",model.stats)
model.stats <- detail_emo_neuref("DefaultC",model.stats)
model.stats <- detail_emo_neuref("HIPP",model.stats)
model.stats <- detail_emo_neuref("AMYG",model.stats)
```


## Figure 2c (network activity by valence)
```{r}
include_rois <- c("DefaultA","DefaultB","DefaultC")

# Summarize data
alldata %>%
  filter(network %in% include_rois) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(network,levels=include_rois)) %>%
  group_by(subID,ROI,network,periodLabel,valenceCategory) %>% # average across trials
  summarize(meanActivity = mean(regulationActivity,na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(subID,network,periodLabel,valenceCategory) %>% # average across ROIs 
  summarize(meanNet = mean(meanActivity)) -> subdata

subdata %>%
  filter(valenceCategory=="neu") %>%
  mutate(meanNeutral = meanNet) %>%
  select(subID,network,periodLabel,meanNeutral) -> subdata.neu

subdata %>%
  left_join(subdata.neu,by=c("subID","network","periodLabel")) %>%
  mutate(valenceDiff = meanNet - meanNeutral) -> subdata

subdata %>%
  group_by(network,periodLabel,valenceCategory) %>% # then average across subjects
  summarize(meanAct = mean(meanNet),
            seAct = se(meanNet)) -> meandata

network_names <- list(
  'DMN-A'="Core midline",
  'DMN-B'="Dorsomedial",
  'DMN-C'="Medial temporal"
)

network_labeller <- function(variable,value){

subdata %>%
```

# Figure 2d (perceptual x medial temporal)

```{r}
include_rois <- c("DefaultC")
roiData <- network.data %>% filter(network %in% include_rois)
roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory,
                                  levels = c("neu", "neg", "pos"))

# model for DMN-C 
full.model.c <- lmer(regulationActivity ~ visualDets + eventDets +
                       visualDets*valenceCategory + eventDets*valenceCategory +
                       (1|subID), data = roiData)

# plotting function
plot_visualDets_noScatter <- function(cur_model, roiData, ylab) {

  visualDets_seq <- seq(-8, 12, length.out = 100)
  pred_data <- data.frame(
    visualDets = visualDets_seq,
    eventDets = mean(roiData$eventDets),
    valenceCategory = "neu"
  )

  pred_values <- predict(cur_model, newdata = pred_data, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)

  pred_data <- pred_data %>%
    mutate(
      pred  = pred_values$fit,
      se    = pred_values$se.fit,
      lower = pred - 1.96 * se,
      upper = pred + 1.96 * se
    )

  p1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = roiData, aes(x = visualDets, y = regulationActivity), alpha = 0) +
    geom_line(data = pred_data, aes(x = visualDets, y = pred), color = "violet", size = 1) +
    geom_ribbon(data = pred_data, aes(x = visualDets, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                fill = "violet", alpha = 0.2) +
    labs(x = "Perceptual details recalled (mean-centered)", y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal(14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-8, 12), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-.2, .4))

  ggMarginal(p1, type = "histogram", fill = "gray30", size = 10, margins = "x")
}


dw <- plot_visualDets_noScatter(full.model.c, roiData, "MT subnetwork activity")
dw
```

# Figure 3b (perceptual x amygdala)

```{r}
plot_visualDets_noHist <- function(cur_model,roiData,ylab) {
  
  visualDets_seq <- seq(-8, 12, length.out = 100)
  pred_data <- data.frame(
    visualDets = visualDets_seq,
    eventDets = mean(roiData$eventDets),  # Holding eventDets constant at its mean
    valenceCategory = "neu"  # You can specify any level of valenceCategory here
  )
  
  # Get predictions and standard errors using the model
  pred_values <- predict(cur_model, newdata = pred_data, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  # Combine predictions and standard errors into a data frame
  pred_data <- pred_data %>%
    mutate(
      pred = pred_values$fit,
      se = pred_values$se.fit,
      lower = pred - 1.96 * se,  # Lower bound of 95% CI
      upper = pred + 1.96 * se   # Upper bound of 95% CI
    )
  
  # Plot using ggplot2
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    # Individual data points

}
```

```{r}
model.stats <- data.frame()


detail_emo_neuref <- function(curROI,model.stats) {
  
  # model
  roiData <- network.data %>% filter(network %in% curROI)
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("pos", "neu", "neg"))
  full.model <- lmer(regulationActivity ~ visualDets*valenceCategory+eventDets*valenceCategory+ (1|subID), data = roiData)
  print(tab_model(full.model,title="uni detail x emotion, ALT reference"))
                  #,
           # file=paste0("outfiles/network_",curROI,"_rem-only.html")))
  
  # p1 <- plot_model(full.model, type = "pred", 
  #                  terms = c("regSuccess [-2.5:2.5]","conditionName")) + 
  #   theme_minimal(10) + guides(color="none")
  
    stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats,ROI=curROI)
  model.stats <- rbind(model.stats,stats)
  
  return(model.stats)
}
```

# Analysis: anterior/posterior hipp

## setup 
```{r}
# import activity data
subjects <- list.files(path='/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/hipp-recall-block15s/',full.names=TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = 'block15s_timepoint-averages')
actdata2  = do.call(rbind, lapply(subjects, function(x) {read.csv(x, header = TRUE)}))

# join behavioral and activity data 
alldata2 <- left_join(actdata2,behav.all,by=c("subID","videoName","trial"),suffix=c(".act",".beh"))

# define factors 
alldata2$ROI <- as.factor(alldata2$ROI)
alldata2$conditionName <- as.factor(alldata2$conditionName)
alldata2$valenceCategory <- as.factor(alldata2$valenceCategory)
alldata2$subID <- as.factor(alldata2$subID)
alldata2$regRound.categ <- as.factor(alldata2$regRound) # keep both integer & categorical versions
alldata2$videoName <- as.factor(alldata2$videoName)
alldata2$periodLabel <- as.factor(alldata2$periodLabel)
```

```{r}
### add z score of activity estimates within region and subject and time-period
alldata2 <- alldata2 %>%
  group_by(subID, ROI, periodLabel) %>%
  mutate(Z = zscore(regulationActivity)) %>%
  ungroup()

# remove betas that are > 4SD 
tmp <- alldata2 %>%
  mutate(isOutlier = ifelse(abs(Z)>4,TRUE,FALSE))

# Following Cooper & Ritchey, remove trials where mean for ANY ROI is an outlier
outliers <- tmp %>%
  select(isOutlier,subID,trial) %>%
  filter(isOutlier) %>%
  unique()
alldata2 <- left_join(alldata2,outliers,by=c("subID","trial"))
alldata2$isOutlier[is.na(alldata2$isOutlier)] <- FALSE

# Summarize number of outliers
table(alldata2$subID,alldata2$isOutlier)
table(alldata2$isOutlier)

alldata2$regulationActivity[alldata2$isOutlier] <- NA  #mark value as NA if outlier
```

```{r}
# TRIAL FILTERS
alldata2 <- alldata2 %>%
  mutate(isComplete.emo = ifelse(is.na(valenceChange) | is.na(arousalChange),
                             FALSE,TRUE))

# Removing negative reappraisal trials
alldata2 <- alldata2 %>%
  filter(conditionName == "remember")

alldata2 <- alldata2 %>%
  filter(remembered == "1") # remembered-only 
```


```{r}
alldata2 <- alldata2 %>%
  group_by(subID,ROI,periodLabel) %>% 
  mutate(regSuccess = scale(regSuccess,scale=FALSE),
         valenceChange = scale(valenceChange,scale=FALSE),
         arousalChange = scale(arousalChange,scale=FALSE),
         recallVividness = scale(recallVividness,scale=FALSE),
         eventDets = scale(eventDets, scale =FALSE), 
         visualDets = scale(visualDets, scale=FALSE),
         correctDetails = scale(correctDetails, scale=FALSE)) %>% # mean-center within subject
  ungroup()

# double check that this worked as expected
tmp <- alldata2 %>% filter(valenceCategory=="neg" & ROI=="AntHipp_L") %>% group_by(subID) %>% summarize(meansucc = mean(regSuccess,na.rm=TRUE))

```

```{r}
outDir <- '/Volumes/memolab/Data/Behavioral_Online/reframe-details/detail_script_files/reframe-detail_timepoint_results/'
alphafdr <- .05

curFile = paste0(outDir,'lme_hippocampal_rem.csv')
### set up data frame for mixed effect model results:
mixed.data <- data.frame(array(0,c(length(rois)*8,8)))
colnames(mixed.data) <- c('ROI','Period','Predictor','Beta','SE','T','Df','Pvalue')
row = 0

model.data <- alldata2
periodLabel <- as.character(model.data$periodLabel[1])


# ******** run linear mixed effects model within each ROI and store results **********
for (r in 1:length(rois)) {
  
  thisROI <- as.character(rois[r])
  
  roiData <- filter(model.data, ROI == thisROI)
  roiData$regSuccess <- scale(roiData$regSuccess, scale = FALSE) 
  
  # run lmer and get fixed effect stats
    roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "pos", "neg"))
  full.model <- suppressMessages(lmer(regulationActivity ~ valenceCategory*eventDets + valenceCategory*visualDets+
                                         (1|subID), data = roiData))
  stats <- summary(full.model)$coefficients
  nIV <- nrow(stats) - 1 # number of fixed effects, discounting intercept
  
  ### add fixed effects and p values to data frame
  mixed.data$ROI[(row+1):(row+nIV)]      <- thisROI
  mixed.data$Phase[(row+1):(row+nIV)]    <- periodLabel
  mixed.data$Predictor[(row+1):(row+nIV)]  <- row.names(stats)[2:(nIV+1)]
  mixed.data[(row+1):(row+nIV),c("Beta","SE","T","Df","Pvalue")] <- stats[2:(nIV+1),
                                                                          c("Estimate","Std. Error","t value","df","Pr(>|t|)")]
  row = row + nIV
    
}
```
